newsitem.title: UK: Daily Mail TV unit could link with BSkyB.
newsitem.headline: Daily Mail TV unit could link with BSkyB.

text.p: The television arm of Daily Mail & General Trust Plc has confirmed it is in talks with BSkyB about the possible launch of a lifestyle channel.
"We are talking to Sky about a whole range of possibilities and that (a lifestyle channel) is one of them," said Julian Aston, chief executive of the Mail group's Channel One cable television unit.
Aston added the channel was near the top of the agenda and that it might be launched soon if agreement was reached.
A recent newspaper report said that the proposed channel could be named Daily Mail TV.
But Aston dismissed reports that Channel One was exploring the possibility of launching a joint channel with the Mirror Group's LIVE TV cable venture.
"It is about as likely as the sun and the moon getting together," said Aston.
Newspaper reports said that Channel One and LIVE TV were discussing a joint venture in the north east English city of Newscastle, an idea promoted by cable operator Telewest.

Channel One provides local television news for London and Bristol in a fairly conventional format whereas LIVE TV, which broadcasts in London and Birmingham, favours a much more light-hearted approach.

"I don't think it's any secret that we believe that one strong local channel has more chance of surviving than two, even if they are doing different things," said Ian Hood, head of corporate affairs at Telewest.
He said Telewest had been talking to Mirror Group about the possibilites of a Scottish version of LIVE TV.
